retained_motion_scope: Same retained locomotion and sit experts, zero new updates. Seven final motions passed in each condition; original summary/checkpoint/raw SHA were compared across conditions. Their raw arrays were not replayed locally in this collection.

independent_recalculation.scope: All recorded samples through first terminal, including short failures. Same frozen numerical evaluators, not a new GPU evaluation.

publication_scope: Selected authored simulation results and three authorized comparison videos only. Source identities are hashes; no source arrays, models, private materials or connection details are distributed.
limitations: No condition achieved all nine motion criteria. The seven passes are retained models with zero new updates, not seven newly learned skills.
Four independent expert policies per condition; no unified actor, continuous switching, disturbance or real hardware validation.
B/C prone and C wave stopped early. Maxima from short recordings are not full-duration performance.
A wave improves slightly in a single deterministic evaluation. B/C preflight uses modified control/reference; compare paired preflight/final before attributing learning effects.
The14second digest does not replace full episode criteria. B/C prone short failures are held as stills; C wave fails after the displayed excerpt.
New PLA reinforcement is not included in D17. Hardware strength and fit remain unverified.
